meta.no_hyphen_rule: No hyphens, en dashes or em dashes in any delivered text. Official form and registration numbers keep their format.

notes: The Supreme Court struck down the IEEPA tariffs on February 20, 2026.
The 10% Section 122 surcharge ran February 24 to July 24, 2026 and expired.
A Section 301 forced labor action took effect in late July 2026 adding 12.5% on all China origin goods, stacking on the existing China Section 301 list rates and on the MFN rate.
A second Section 301 investigation opened in March 2026 is still pending (stress case adds 10 points).
A CBP binding ruling decides the base rate (8544.42 versus 8544.70); the 12.5% applies either way.
De minimis is gone. Every China origin shipment needs formal entry. No parcel dropship model.

entity.delaware_note: only worth it for raising investment
entity.boi_reporting: not required for US formed companies (FinCEN finalized the exemption August 11, 2026)
entity.form_5472: A foreign owned single member LLC files Form 5472 with a pro forma Form 1120 every year
entity.ein: EIN by phone or fax with Form SS-4, no SSN needed
entity.legal_name_rule: Exact legal name match across state, IRS, bank, Amazon
entity.ownership_default: Lucy owns 100%; Mark paid under a written consulting or commission agreement
entity.partnership_warning: If Mark becomes an owner the LLC becomes a partnership with Form 1065 and 37% withholding on her share of profit
entity.alternative: Mark's own US company acts as distributor and importer of record with Lucy staying at the wholesale layer

us_tax.rule: Business profits are taxed only where the permanent establishment sits
us_tax.fba_no_pe: Goods stored and shipped from FBA warehouses do not create a PE (Article 9(3)(b))
conditions: no agent in the US who negotiates or signs contracts
us_tax.california_nexus: California may assert income tax nexus from FBA inventory; on the CPA list

korea.registration_meaning: middle digits 64 indicate a Korean sole proprietorship, not a corporation
korea.incorporate_first_question: flag the incorporate H2 first question for the Korean tax accountant
korea.odi_report: Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, Lucy must report overseas direct investment to her foreign exchange bank before capital moves (any stake of 10% or more, any amount)
korea.enforcement_note: Enforcement against individual online sellers is rising

trademark.rule: Foreign applicants must file through a US licensed attorney
trademark.brand_registry: Amazon Brand Registry accepts a pending application

amazon.bank: USD bank account (Mercury or Relay for the LLC; Payoneer or WorldFirst as fallback)

compliance.hdmi_adopter: The factory must be an HDMI Adopter with ATC test reports; HDMI LA runs seizures
compliance.naming_rule: Packaging and promotion may not use HDMI version numbers; use the cable category name (Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable). Listing titles may state 48Gbps and 8K.
compliance.category_4k: Premium High Speed HDMI Cable (pending certification; placeholder)
compliance.fcc: AOC heads contain active electronics, so obtain the factory FCC test report
compliance.cl3: Get CL3 documentation before claiming in wall
compliance.marketing_language: fiber optic HDMI or hybrid active optical is accurate; never claim pure fiber or all glass

logistics.first_lots: air DDP for the first 5 hero SKUs at 100 to 300 units each
logistics.three_pl: 3PL for bulk inventory with FBA fed from it
logistics.ocean: ocean freight only on proven SKUs

order: eBay as overflow at near zero incremental effort
B2B installer and AV integrator in Year 2
Amazon Canada and the pro line in Years 4 and 5
channels.temu: only through its local seller program after the Amazon price floor is set; optional, not in the base case

alibaba_benchmark.note: higher than the H2 cost base; the gap is the single largest unverified assumption

critical_path: Wyoming LLC and EIN; exact legal name match across state, IRS, bank, Amazon
Korean overseas direct investment report before the capital transfer
90 day validation with hurdles (conversion, ACOS, return rate, contribution per SKU)
Scale winners on ocean freight, delist losers
differentiators: direction proof design (color coded SOURCE and DISPLAY ends, printed arrows, QR setup video)
5 Year Signal Guarantee with the replacement shipped before the return arrives
Spec Match finder and trade up registration that build an off Amazon email list

positioning.line: Sell the signal, not the cable.
positioning.strategy: Enter narrow. Own long length, high spec fiber where copper physically fails past 3 meters at 48Gbps. Do not compete with $8 copper.
